rounding: All values and thresholds are absolute fractions of problems (0.02 = 2 points). Comparisons round to 9 places (qwen_updates.r9); >= and < as written; a missing value or an empty pool reads 'missing', never a verdict.

graders.relaxed: experiments/qwen_rl/relaxed.py: the last match of "[Tt]he answer is" with any prefix, optional $, \boxed{, **, equals the gold number.

pools.three_state: GSM8K test, problems whose answers fit the window at W0, R and N of that seed (P1's drop rule); W0 is acc/W0_gsm8k.jsonl.
pools.whole: GSM8K test, all 1,319 problems, nothing dropped: whole-answer accuracy, as E69's +4.85 for N. Paired over problems against the state read on the same card.
pools.se: sd of the per-problem differences / sqrt n. Under two problems: se is missing.

G0.measure: RL minus null, seed 1, relaxed, three_state pool, in points to two places, as printed

S0.measure: R2's gain in R.json (P1's reading, drop rule), GSM8K test, strict
S0.fail: anything but learns: S1, S1r and S2 are reported as read, not scored

S1.measure: R2 minus N2, three_state pool, strict
S1.rule: replicates if diff >= 0.02 and diff >= 2 SE; no lead if diff < 0.01; ambiguous otherwise, so a diff of 0.02 or more under 2 SE is ambiguous and a negative diff is no lead.

S1r.measure: as S1, relaxed; the verdict sentence is this row's
S1r.lean: ambiguous or no lead; seed 1 reads +1.25

S2.measure: N2's gain in N.json (P3's reading, drop rule), GSM8K test, strict; N1's sign from lr1e-6w10/N.json (+5.63)
S2.rule: systematic if |gain| >= 0.015 with N1's sign; one-seed walk if |gain| < 0.015; opposite sign if |gain| >= 0.015 against N1's sign (the plan's rule has no branch for it: added before filing).

saved_control.measure: W0 rescored on the job's card against A0: per set, gap = |strict_dropped - A0's| and f = the number of problems whose (fits, strict) changed from acc/W0_<set>.jsonl, over W0's fitting problems. N100 rebuilt from its dW: |strict_dropped - N.json's| <= f, per set, so exact if f is 0.
saved_control.why_f_is_flips: The plan's f is the gap. A gap can cancel to 0 with answers changed, and two noise draws make N100's gap exceed W0's about half the time per set: the gap would stop the job on noise. The flip share bounds the gap and is 0 only when nothing changed. Both are recorded.
saved_control.gap_max_source: P0's tol: a W0 further off is not a card floor
saved_control.amended: 2026-11-04, after the first N100 read and before any state it guards: N100's check is now per-problem, flips of (fits, strict) against the pod's acc/N_<set>.jsonl <= flips_max per set. As filed, f is W0's flips, 0 on this card, so one changed answer stops the job: the first read had 1 of 1,319 GSM8K answers changed (idx 31, ran past the window; gap 1.1e-4) and 0 of 1,197 GSM1K. W0 cannot measure this floor: it is not rebuilt from a saved dW. flips_max 3 is three times the larger read and 0.23 points of GSM8K, under B1's nearest band gap of 1.4 points; a wrong state flips far more (N100 and W0 differ on hundreds). Cause of the one flip not established.

B1.measure: N50 minus W0 on the same card, whole pool, strict; each seed read alone
B1.rule: diff >= 0.024: arrives; diff < 0.01, negative included: after; between: no call.

E_R10.measure: R10 minus W0 on the same card, whole pool, lenient; seed 1
E_R10.rule: expected, not a verdict: holds if |diff| <= 0.01.

openings_control.measure: W0 prefilled with its own first two words, GSM8K test, against W0 rescored on the same card: response, response_tokens and truncated equal on every problem.
openings_control.own_opening: the fewest tokens of W0's response on this card (W0card, retokenised) whose text holds two words, so the opening ends on a token boundary. Checked on acc/W0_gsm8k.jsonl: all 1,319 are token prefixes; cutting at the second word's end instead fails on one problem (idx 26, ':\n\n' is one token).
openings_control.floor: If any problem differs: plain W0 once more at batch 127, which changes every row's padding; the count of problems that differs there is the floor. Holds if the prefilled count <= the floor. CLAUDE.md: a control that two numeric paths agree takes its tolerance from a measured noise floor (the rule's letter of exact identity would stop on a batch's rounding).

A1.measure: W0 prefilled 'We are' minus W0 on the same card, whole pool, strict

labels.carries: the opening carries the null's gain

A1.rule: diff >= 0.024: carries; diff <= 0: not; between: part.

A2.measure: N100 rebuilt minus N100 prefilled with W0's own openings, same card, whole pool, strict: the loss
A2.rule: loss >= 0.02425 (half of 4.85, absolute, not re-read on the card): the opening carries it; otherwise not, a negative loss included.

unfiled: The two-seed spread of the lead; the relaxed and drop-rule columns of the saved steps and openings; W0 prefilled 'We need'; GSM1k.
